title: CreateUserInvitationRequest
description:
Request model for creating a new user invitation.

This model is used to invite a new user to join an organization. The invitation
will be sent to the specified email address and will include the roles that will
be assigned to the user upon acceptance.

name.description: Display name for the invited user

email.description: Email address to send the invitation to

roles.description: List of roles to assign to the user

resource.description: Optional resource type the role applies to (e.g., 'dataset')

resource_instance.description: Optional resource instance ID the role applies to

Role.description: Role model for user and client roles
Role.title: Role
